snippet.title: Blood Dungeon - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
From the creators of Nidhogg, murder hordes of monsters in this 2D platforming autoshooter with a killer soundtrack. Collect Blood, gold, and bones to increase your powers. Can you survive the Blood Dungeon? blooddungeon.com 

Coming late summer 2026 to PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S
